text:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from the EU failover yesterday. Consolidating remediation owners + timelines. I'll kick off — please react with :white_check_mark: if you own an item or propose changes.

devon: I'll own the routing-policy rollback automation task. Can run first patch this week. ETA Fri 15:00 UTC.

alyssa: Backup verification: last successful snapshot check shows failures for eu-west-1 on 2026-03-15 02:12Z. Logs: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/eu-west-1/2026-03-15.meta FAILED: PermissionDenied
```
I can debug Mon morning.

samir: I'll update the restore runbook (cross-region DB restore section). Plan: draft by Tue EOD. @maria please assign the PR review.

maria: Assigning owners: routing automation -> devon; backup fix -> alyssa; restore runbook -> samir; game-day rehearsal coordinator -> chandra. Target dates: routing Fri, backup Tue, runbook Tue, game-day next Thu. If you need more time say now.

chandra: Noted recurring pattern: regional traffic spike + AZ flapping leads to stale route-table cache and delayed failover. Propose adding cache-bust healthcheck and a TTL refresh on our edge routers. Will prototype a simple probe this week.

ops-bot: Document created: https://redwood.docs/runbooks/dr/sequenced-remediations-2439000123 (automated snapshot).

emily: Quick ask: please add risk & rollback notes to the restore runbook (who runs the rollback, estimated RTO, and KMS key assumptions). Also confirm backup KMS access for oncall.

samir: Ack. I'll add risk/rollback and a short checklist. Will include quick commands for dry-run:
```
rds restore --region eu-west-1 --snapshot latest
```

devon: Game-day scheduling: propose Thu 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC for rehearsal (eng-sre, eng-platform, product). Will create invite and pregame checklist.

maria: Works for me. Devon — add calendar + a short runbook walkthrough before the exercise. I'll follow up in 48h to confirm PRs and blockers. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
